repository_observation.claim_scope: Read-only GitHub API observations before the first scaffold upload; not a persistent assertion about current remote settings.

findings.observation: The complete scaffold was absent from recoverable Git history and hosted validation.
findings.correction: Preserve the scaffold in commit 32fbd495bd2cdf3b30347f1f55ff3b02f0526118 and use coherent task-branch checkpoints.
findings.remaining: Initial public upload and hosted execution require owner publication authorization.

findings.observation: A local fast pass, branch push or unrelated green workflow could be confused with current delivery.
findings.correction: Expose checkpoint and hosted states separately, require latest commit-bound results and preserve original CI evidence provenance.
findings.remaining: Metadata and digests do not authenticate fabricated reports; retrieve artifacts using official authenticated gh.

findings.observation: Future long-running acceptance would make every local checkpoint unnecessarily expensive.
findings.correction: Keep fast and affected local checks, full Linux/Windows PR checks and manual release-cadence validation; add dependency/build caches and duration feedback.
findings.remaining: Split jobs or introduce scheduled/paid capacity only after measured demand.

findings.observation: Main is unprotected; a workflow file alone does not prevent bypass.
findings.correction: Record required integration policy and the follow-up in the native-verification task.
findings.remaining: Configure GitHub protection using observed successful job names and owner-authorized repository administration.

retained_failure.cause: A pre-existing synthetic source-drift test omitted log fields now validated before report emission.
retained_failure.correction: Supply a real fixture log and digest without weakening the report schema.

primary_references.use: Pull-request versus push triggers and merge-checkout provenance.
Cache scope, keys and restore behavior; cache hits are not verification evidence.
Set up pnpm before enabling its setup-node cache.
